title: Reading Drill — Choosing What to Digitise
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Choosing What to Digitise
passages.body:
**A** A library could scan only part of its manuscript collection. Staff placed documents with frequent requests high on the list so handling of the originals could be reduced.

**B** The plan also identified fragile documents that could not be scanned safely on an ordinary flatbed. A camera stand would allow those books to remain partly closed.

**C** Staff published a timetable of planned scanning dates. Anyone with an upcoming research visit could ask the archive to schedule a manuscript sooner.
